name: Rum River (Walbo–St. Francis)
gaugeName: Rum River near St. Francis, MN

gaugeContext.note: The St. Francis gauge is downstream of these trips. It provides same-river flow context, not conditions at every landing or a calibrated paddling speed.

timing.note: No reviewed flow-to-speed model. A matching DNR paddling-time range is shown only for Martins–North County Park.

blurb: Choose shorter paddles around Cambridge or continue from Martins Landing to North County Park. Compare source-backed access locations, river-mile distances and available DNR trip guidance.

sections.takeOut: Rum River Cambridge West Park Access
sections.difficulty: Moderate current; downed trees and snags possible
sections.notes: The DNR map’s longer Walbo–Cambridge paddle. Finish at the public park carry-in near Highway 95, not the downstream campsite. Arrange a vehicle shuttle.
sections.routeReview: Approximate agency river-course overview. Exact landing connections and obstacle passages are not mapped.

takeOut.name: Rum River Cambridge West Park Access

distanceEvidence.note: 56.8 minus 42.6 gives approximately 14.2 river miles. The current PDF identifies the carry-in at mile 42.6, separate from the campsite at mile 41.0. The webpage’s 15.8-mile Walbo trip uses the campsite mile; it is not applied to this public take-out. Inventory mile 42.4 is not mixed with map miles.

putInAccess.operator: Minnesota DNR, Division of Parks and Trails
putInAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — 2026 Rum River map and access inventory
putInAccess.note: Digitized DNR point lies in the river beside the Highway 95 bridge. Public trailer access is documented in the 2026 map and inventory; exact ramp location is not established by this point.
putInAccess.directions: Reach the public access from Verdin Street via County Road 1 south of Highway 95, west of Cambridge. Follow the access entrance to the river; the marker near the bridge is an approximate area, not the launch itself.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — 2026 Rum River map and access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: DNR GPS point is at the wooded bank south of Highway 95 beside the park approach. Exact water-edge landing remains uncertain. The 2026 map places the carry-in at mile 42.6; inventory says 42.4. The separate campsite is mile 41.0.
takeOutAccess.directions: From Highway 95 in Cambridge, follow South Fern Street and 2nd Avenue SW to City Park on the west bank. Find the public carry-in near the highway bridge. This is not the downstream watercraft campsite.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Anoka County Parks and Minnesota DNR access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Unchanged DNR GPS coordinate matches the visible shoreline end of the park carry-in steps/approach. The 2026 river map and county park page independently document this canoe/kayak access. Desktop landing review, not a field survey; water levels and approach conditions may change.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use Rum River North County Park at 23100 Rum River Boulevard NW, St. Francis. Follow the signed carry-in near Bridge Street; boats must be carried to the river, not launched on trailers.
